scope: duplicate / clone verification across all 3995 games (Round 1 + Round 2)

same_name_clusters.note: clusters of entries whose normalized game name is identical; dup_repo_name=yes marks the strongest same-game signal (identical repo name under a different owner, i.e. a fork/re-release)

clone_families.note: same game CONCEPT implemented independently (e.g. many Tetris clones). Members are NOT duplicates of one game; recommended=BEST marks the highest-starred implementation to pick

method.url_check: exact + normalized (lowercase, strip .git and trailing slash) repo URL comparison
method.name_check: name normalization (lowercase, alphanumeric only, strip trailing generic words: game/games/js/html/web/clone/remake/the/app/engine/2d/3d/android/free/original/new/open, .io suffix)
method.fork_check: identical normalized repo-name under different owners inside a same-name cluster
method.family_check: 42 classic-game keywords matched against squashed name+description+topics (with sponge/bookworm false-positive guards for pong/worms)
method.recommendation: recommended=BEST = max stars (tiebreak: latest last_updated); is_latest=yes = most recent last_updated

notable_findings.finding: space-wizards/space-station-14 (main project) and space-syndicate/space-station-14 (fork build) - same game re-released
